stem: ![](asset:P000041-stem-1)A block P of mass m is placed on a horizontal frictionless plane. A second block Q of the same mass m is placed on it and is connected to a spring of spring constant k, the two blocks are pulled by a distance A. Block Q oscillates without slipping. What is the maximum value of frictional force between the two blocks?

assets.alt: Block Q resting on block P on a horizontal floor. Q is joined to a wall by a horizontal spring of constant k; the friction coefficient between Q and P is μ.
